current_batch26_obligations.obligation: Define ν:N→R via existing N→Q→R embeddings and check operation/order compatibility. A rational exterior r of any cut A and a positive natural Q bound give A⊆ν(n); r itself witnesses strictness. Prove natural-image unboundedness with correct quantifiers and two-sided bounds without real absolute value.

ForX>0 use legal Y/X,RA1 and positive multiplication-back to obtainν(n)X>Y. Forε>0 chooseν(n)>Inv(ε)>0, use already proved positive inverse reversal and double inverse to obtain0<Inv(ν(n))<ε and rational compatibility. n=0 and ε=0 excluded; no sequence limit or general finite-sum interface is introduced.

ForA<B take rationalr∈B\A then largers∈B. ShowA<i(s) usingr as strict witness andi(s)<B usings as distinct strict witness. The first pointr alone may yieldi(r)=A; do not use square roots, Archimedean instance, floor or surjectivity of rational embedding.

Givenε>0 form positive half-widthE withE+E=ε by legal division and multiplication-back. ApplyRA3 twice and combine strict inequalities using negation/translation; express width asi(q−p), reflectp<q and prove both positive side errors<ε. Eachε has witnesses, not a uniform algorithm or infinite choice.

Define real square as self-product only. Reprove all-sign nonnegativity/zero criterion, positive and negative perturbation expansions and difference-of-squares from actualR distribution. Cross terms need commutation and2=1+1. Strict/weak comparison and reflection apply only to nonnegative inputs; show negative-input counterexample.

ForA≥0, S_A={X∈R:0≤X andX²≤A} is a subset of cuts. Zero gives nonempty; U=A+1 withU²>A bounds it; DC4 gives s≥0 but not yet s∈S_A. Ifs²<A, explicitly define two-inputmin, takeh=min(1,(A−s²)/(2s+2))>0 and prove strict perturbation chain. Ifs²>A, s>0 and0<δ≤s²; h=δ/(2s)≤s/2 via multiplication-back, t=s−h>0,t<s,t²=A+h²>A. Prove everyX∈S_A lies belowt before callingt an upper bound and invoking leastness. This proof is independent ofRA1–RA4.

Nonnegative square reflection gives uniqueness after existence. Define sqrt_R only from nonnegativeR to nonnegativeR; root sign,zero andone follow by candidates/uniqueness. Rational compatibility uses old partialsqrt_Q only onS_Q; reverse rational-image root implies rational-square membership via embedding reflection and injectivity.

Positive case verifies±s then proves exhaustion by difference-of-squares and zero-product law, without dividing a possiblyzero difference.
